record.question: Which of the following statements is false regarding lapse of sanctions?
options: A sanction shall lapse if no payment in whole or in part has been made during a period of twelve months
When the period of currency of the sanctions is specified in the sanction itself, it shall lapse on the expiry of such periods
When the budget provision for the sanction lapses at the end of that Financial Year, the sanction also lapses
The lapse of a financial sanction affects only the accounting treatment of expenditure and does not affect the authority to incur expenditure
